newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank -no large buyer pushing shares.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank -no large buyer pushing shares.

text.p: Germany's Commerzbank AG said on Thursday that the strong rise in its share price was largely due to the fact that the shares were earlier undervalued.
The bank also said that it saw no one single large investor buying up the group's shares.

"You can forget those rumours that there is one large speculative buyer," a Commerzbank spokesman said. He added that the bank's analyst meeting on Wednesday was clearly positive and that this was also helping the stock climb. "The share price, as compared with other banks, is undervalued," he added.
Commerzbank shares jumped over five percent in IBIS trading
Commerzbank shares traded up 1.45 marks at 36.75 in early floor trading and dealers said strong interest in the shares was also helping pull up other bank shares.
